title: Langmuir capture extracted from the cryopanel: equations, invariants and the independent check
note: scientific/models/surface_adsorption.py holds the physics directive 22 extracted from the cryopanel component model, and scientific/checks/langmuir_rk4.py checks it independently. Each mutation is a generic scientific or trust error (wrong flux, wrong volume factor, dropped thermal dependence, accepted NaN, self-certification); tests/test_surface_adsorption.py must notice.

mutations.name: SA1_the_flux_prefactor_doubled
mutations.rationale: wrong boundary flux: the impingement flux is twice the kinetic-theory value

mutations.name: SA2_the_mean_speed_loses_pi
mutations.rationale: the Maxwell-Boltzmann mean speed off by sqrt(pi)

mutations.name: SA3_density_ignores_temperature
mutations.rationale: thermal dependence dropped: the number density of a room-temperature gas at every temperature

mutations.name: SA4_capacity_leaves_the_exponent
mutations.rationale: wrong volume factor: the capture rate is not scaled by the capacity, and the surface saturates at once

mutations.name: SA5_sticking_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: every molecule that strikes the surface sticks

mutations.name: SA6_no_capacity_guard
mutations.rationale: an over-full inventory handed in grows past capacity

mutations.name: SA7_a_negative_window_runs
mutations.find:
if dt < 0:
        raise ValueError("dt_s must be >= 0")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        raise ValueError("dt_s must be >= 0")
mutations.rationale: time runs backwards and the inventory with it

mutations.name: SA8_zero_sticking_is_computed
mutations.find: if sticking <= 0.0 or flux <= 0.0 or dt == 0.0:
mutations.rationale: a non-sticking surface is pushed through the exponential and its inventory moves by rounding

mutations.name: SA9_bounded_is_never_checked
mutations.rationale: an inventory outside [0, N_cap] is reported as holding

mutations.name: SA10_capture_only_is_never_checked
mutations.rationale: a window that loses inventory is reported as holding

mutations.name: SA11_incidence_is_never_checked
mutations.rationale: a capture beyond the incident fluence is reported as holding

mutations.name: SA12_composition_is_never_checked
mutations.rationale: a stepping formula that is not the law's solution is reported as holding

mutations.name: SA13_non_finite_is_not_counted
mutations.find: nonfinite = sum(1 for v in values if not math.isfinite(v))
mutations.rationale: accept NaN: a non-finite inventory is published as a result

mutations.name: SA14_the_closed_form_spans_one_window
mutations.find: closed = langmuir_capture(N0, flux, s, cap, dt * n_win)
mutations.replace: closed = langmuir_capture(N0, flux, s, cap, dt)
mutations.rationale: the composition reference is not the whole exposure

mutations.name: SA15_the_fluence_is_not_accumulated
mutations.rationale: the admitted fluence is one window's, whatever the count

mutations.name: SA16_the_initial_coverage_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: a covered surface is treated as bare

mutations.name: RK1_the_pressure_form_loses_two
mutations.rationale: the check's own flux is wrong, and a correct producer would fail

mutations.name: RK2_the_rk4_weights_are_uniform
mutations.rationale: the integrator is not fourth order

mutations.name: RK3_saturation_is_declared_early
mutations.rationale: the integration stops while the vacancy is still resolvable

mutations.name: RK4_every_comparison_passes
mutations.find: status=Status.PASS if rel <= REL_MAX else Status.FAIL,
mutations.rationale: self-certify: the check passes whatever it measured

mutations.name: RK5_the_flux_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: a flux error on a saturated surface is invisible

mutations.name: RK6_the_stated_resolution_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: digits the producer never claimed are held against it

mutations.name: RK7_failed_outputs_are_compared
mutations.find:
if flux_out.status is not OutputStatus.OK or \
            inv_out.status is not OutputStatus.OK:
mutations.rationale: a failed run is compared as though it had outputs

mutations.name: RK8_any_model_is_checked
mutations.rationale: the check speaks to a model it was not written for

mutations.name: CAT1_the_check_is_not_admitted
mutations.rationale: the model declares a check the catalog will not resolve
